jobs.name: hero-run
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a NEW production animation sprite sheet of the exact developer swordsman in the reference: short dark hair, charcoal jacket, teal hood and trailing scarf, leather boots, glowing cyan sword. Preserve this character identity, rendering quality, proportions and painterly comic-book style. Output 1536x1024 with genuine transparent alpha. STRICT layout 4 columns by 2 rows, each cell exactly384x512; no labels or grid. EIGHT consecutive frames of ONE smooth side-view running cycle facing RIGHT, ordered left-to-right then second row. The character is running in place. Frame 1 left foot contacting ahead, 2 left leg bearing weight/right knee passing, 3 left leg pushing off/right leg extending, 4 airborne transition, 5 right foot contacting ahead, 6 right leg bearing weight/left knee passing, 7 right leg pushing off/left leg extending, 8 airborne transition back to frame1. Same torso angle, face, size, outfit, sword length in EVERY frame. Keep HEAD CENTER at local x200 y102 and PELVIS at local x192 y286 in ALL cells, grounded feet near y445, consistent body scale; only limbs and cape move in a natural stride. Sword held low on right with tip down, same hand throughout. Thin teal scarf sways smoothly. Whole figure inside x35..350 y50..460 EACH cell with 30px transparent safety margin, do not cross cell boundaries. Exactly8 distinct successive poses, not duplicates. No floor, no background, no ground shadows or background glow.

jobs.name: ground
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image sets exact material/painting style only. Generate a new game-ready HORIZONTALLY TILEABLE continuous ground strip for this dark fantasy side-scrolling game. Wide landscape 1536x512 (3:1). The entire image shows only a mossy cobblestone causeway from a shallow elevated side-on view. Detailed irregular blue-grey slate cobblestones, fine fractures, desaturated jade moss in joints, soft cold teal lighting, bold delicate ink lines, painterly surfaces matching reference. Top edge is perfectly level horizontally and shows thin back lip of paving. Top75% image is the broad traversable road surface with several rows of roughly equal sized stones; bottom25% is its vertical stone front face disappearing into dark shadow. LEFT AND RIGHT EDGES MATCH PERFECTLY as a seamless repeating horizontal strip: identical height, lightness, stone row alignment and texture scale, no distinctive objects near either edge. Uniform ambient lighting throughout width; no gradient from left to right, no single central feature. No trees, roots across path, crystals, ruins, pillars, characters, water, skyline, void above, text, UI, grid or cast shadows from off-screen objects. Road fills the image from top to bottom, continuous planar surface, no perspective vanishing point, no curved edges. It must tile infinitely left-to-right without visible seams. Opaque background.
